target.statement: Mean test AUC of logistic regression on the parity5 dataset (sample size 32, 5 features) is 0.17.

compute.basis: Logistic regression on a 32-sample dataset with 3-fold CV and a 4-value lambda grid is trivial; the main cost is installing the tabmini package and its dependencies (scikit-learn, MOSEK, etc.) and downloading the tiny dataset.

title: PMLBmini: A Tabular Classification Benchmark Suite for Data-Scarce Applications
